activationRequirements: Verify actual active production version(s) and exact test version resource bindings
Confirm ownership of proposed names before creating resources; do not reuse unknown pre-existing resources
Use new D1 and private R2 resources, never clone production records or credential material
Start with cron disabled, no public custom routes and no Gmail/CMS/deployment credentials
Use separate test administrator credentials through protected Secrets, not source control
Review schema-only initialization and minimal synthetic .invalid seed site
Verify a backup before any approved mutation of existing data
Review authenticated draft routes, quotas, retention and safe site deletion before enabling a writer
